findings: File and SQLite crash-boundary runs preserve one durable Submitted intent and prevent a second Venue call across pre-effect and lost-response crashes.
An ambiguous submit remains Unknown across reopen and cannot be retried until authoritative Venue facts and fresh clean reconciliation resolve it; both Accepted and Rejected paths are covered.

Worker recovery tests hold the execution cursor until the command outcome and reconciliation resolve, then persist the host catalog and constructed/initialized lifecycle observation before committing progress.
The deployment readiness projection consumes the recovered observation; the fixture correctly leaves trading_enabled=null because the evidence is not authoritative live readiness.
limitations: This is Windows unit/integration evidence using simulated Venue state; it does not exercise a real venue.
PostgreSQL and Linux worker recovery, plus an authorized live/testnet integration, remain outstanding.
